source_note: Third-party archive of official NFL box scores (2021-2022). Thresholds (qb_line, wr_line) are PROXY lines from a rolling mean, not sportsbook prices.

combo.leg_a: QB passing yards over proxy line
combo.leg_b: WR1 receiving yards over proxy line
combo.verdict: positive dependence: joint probability exceeds the product of the marginals, so an independent-lines parlay UNDERPRICES this combo

yard_level_correlation.label: QB passing yards vs WR1 receiving yards, same team-game

G2_min_sample.detail: n=803 team-games but only 2021-2022 seasons (2 < 3 required)

G7_pricing.detail: No archived prop prices and no 2026 player feed. Proxy lines are not tradeable prices.

gates.status: Blocked - research-only. No prop strategy can be scored on the betting leaderboard.

what_would_unblock_it: An official or licensed 2026 player-level box-score feed (nfl.com/stats is client-rendered and the stats download policy must be respected).
An archived sportsbook price history for player props including same-game-parlay repricing.
A minimum of three seasons of player-level data so the >=300-bet / >=3-season gate can be met.
